parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client idempotency token. The server checks whether a request with the same ClientToken has been made. If yes, the server returns the result of the previous call.

parameters.name: Logistics
parameters.description: The logistics address for this order. This parameter is typically valid for orders of physical products.

sub_parameters.name: Code
sub_parameters.description: The code of the Nth module property. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. If multiple module properties exist, concatenate them in the format of N=1, 2, 3...N.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the Nth module property. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription period. Unit: months. For yearly subscription products, specify a multiple of 12.

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription period.

- PricingCycle=1: The unit of the subscription period is year.

- PricingCycle=2: The unit of the subscription period is month.

- PricingCycle=3: The unit of the subscription period is day.

Default value: PricingCycle=2.

This parameter is applicable only to specific product types (ProductType is ddos_originpre_public_cn, ddosDip, ddoscoo, ddos_originpre_public_intl, ddosDip_intl, or ddoscoo_intl).

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The product code. You can call the **QueryProductList** operation to query the product code.

parameters.name: RenewPeriod
parameters.description:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months.
> This parameter is required when you set **RenewalStatus** to **AutoRenewal** in Settings.

parameters.name: RenewalStatus
parameters.description:
The auto-renewal status. Valid values:
- AutoRenewal: auto-renewal is enabled.
- ManualRenewal: manual renewal.

Default value: ManualRenewal.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
- Subscription: subscription.
- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.
